title: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
description: Mold, shape, form, cast, or carve products such as food products, figurines, tile, pipes, and candles consisting of clay, glass, plaster, concrete, stone, or combinations of materials.

projection.title: Molders, shapers, and casters, except metal and plastic

tasks.text: Read work orders or examine parts to determine parts or sections of products to be produced.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Trim or remove excess material, using scrapers, knives, or band saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Brush or spray mold surfaces with parting agents or insert paper into molds to ensure smoothness and prevent sticking or seepage.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying parting agents is manual mold prep

dwas.name: Apply parting agents or other solutions to molds.

tasks.text: Engrave or stamp identifying symbols, letters, or numbers on products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Engraving requires controlled hand tool operation

dwas.name: Engrave designs, text, or other markings onto materials, workpieces, or products.

tasks.text: Assemble, insert, and adjust wires, tubes, cores, fittings, rods, or patterns into molds, using hand tools and depth gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mold building is hands-on craft work

dwas.name: Build production molds.

tasks.text: Clean, finish, and lubricate molds and mold parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of lubricants to workpieces

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.
Apply lubricants or coolants to workpieces.

tasks.text: Separate models or patterns from molds and examine products for accuracy.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing workpieces from molds is physical

dwas.name: Remove workpieces from molds.

tasks.text: Set the proper operating temperature for each casting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Load or stack filled molds in ovens, dryers, or curing boxes, or on storage racks or carts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on stacking of finished items

dwas.name: Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.
Load items into ovens or furnaces.

tasks.text: Align and assemble parts to produce completed products, using gauges and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Assemble metal or plastic parts or products.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Operate and adjust controls of heating equipment to melt material or to cure, dry, or bake filled molds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Operate heating or drying equipment.

tasks.text: Select sizes and types of molds according to instructions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Patch broken edges or fractures, using clay or plaster.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Filling cracks is manual finishing work

dwas.name: Fill cracks, imperfections, or holes in products or workpieces.

tasks.text: Withdraw cores or other loose mold members after castings solidify.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing workpieces from molds is physical

dwas.name: Remove workpieces from molds.

tasks.text: Repair mold defects, such as cracks or broken edges, using patterns, mold boxes, or hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual shaping and fitting of physical templates and molds

dwas.name: Repair templates, patterns, or molds.

tasks.text: Measure and cut products to specified dimensions, using measuring and cutting instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Smooth surfaces of molds, using scraping tools or sandpaper.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand finishing of metal edges with tools

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.

tasks.text: Measure ingredients and mix molding, casting material, or sealing compounds to prescribed consistencies, according to formulas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.

tasks.text: Remove excess materials and level and smooth wet mold mixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Verify dimensions of products, using measuring instruments, such as calipers, vernier gauges, or protractors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Bore holes or cut grates, risers, or pouring spouts in molds, using power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.
Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Tap or tilt molds to ensure uniform distribution of materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting mold position is hands-on machine work

dwas.name: Adjust position of molds during processing.

tasks.text: Construct or form molds for use in casting clay or plaster objects, using plaster, fiberglass, rubber, casting machines, patterns, or flasks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mold building is hands-on craft work

dwas.name: Build production molds.

tasks.text: Pour, pack, spread, or press plaster, concrete, or other materials into or around models or molds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.
